about: The A1 licence test (docs/design/13-driver.md). npc runs it (dialogue/thay_muoi.json); vehicle is the school's bike (vehicles.json), lent to a player on the practical; the player gets on within mount_within seconds, then rides the checkpoints in order within time_limit seconds without getting off. Checkpoints are Blender XY metres with a radius r; they sit on Thủ Thiêm's streets, which the test shares with nobody else. The real driving yard (figure 8, narrow line) replaces this route once its design is approved.
